caption: The video captures an indoor polar bear exhibit, where a broad pool of blue water sits behind a glass wall, framed by artificial white rock formations resembling ice. An orange raft and a row of blue barrels rest near the far edge. In the dim foreground, silhouetted spectators watch the tank, and one visitor on the right holds a smartphone aloft to record the scene. At the center of the water, the polar bear floats on its back, its pale head and raised paws breaking the surface as it drifts leisurely. Over the visible portion, the bear gradually turns its body, drawing its hind paws together as the supine posture shifts toward an upright orientation. The head rotates to face the viewing glass. The bear's body sinks lower so that its pale submerged form is seen through the tank wall beneath the water line. The recording visitor keeps the phone raised toward the bear. Other onlookers remain seated at the base of the tank, heads silhouetted against the glowing blue water. The artificial snowy backdrop stays constant.
